 UP NEET 2026 stray vacancy round: DGME releases seat matrix for 115 MBBS, BDS seats, merit list out 
 Written By : Divyani Paul Published On 2026-11-10T12:54:48+05:30   |   Updated On 10 Nov 2026 12:54 PM IST 
 Uttar Pradesh: The Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh, has released the seat matrix for the stray vacancy round of the UP National Eligibility and Entrance Test-Undergraduate ( NEET UG ) Counselling for the academic year 2026, announcing a total of 115 vacant MBBS and BDS seats across government and private medical and dental colleges in the state.
 According to the official seat matrix, a total of 11 seats are available in government institutions, while the remaining 104 seats are listed in private colleges. The document provides institution-wise vacancies for the stray vacancy round, along with category-wise and subcategory-wise seat distribution.
 Also Read: 887 MBBS, BDS seats- UP DGME notifies round 3 NEET counselling 2026 seat matrix As per the seat matrix, the 115 vacant seats are distributed across 52 institutional entries, comprising 39 medical college entries and 13 dental college entries
 To view the seat matrix, click the link below 
 https://medicaldialogues.in/pdf_upload/2026/11/10/seat-matrix-482931.pdf 
 Along with this, the Uttar Pradesh NEET UG 2026 counselling authority has also released the state merit list for the stray vacancy round of undergraduate medical admissions. The merit list contains the details of 2,546 registered candidates participating in the counselling process.
 The merit list includes candidates' roll numbers, names, fathers' names, UP categories, subcategories, NEET UG marks and All India Ranks. According to the document, only candidates who have paid both the registration fee and security money and whose documents have been successfully verified are eligible to participate in online choice filling.
 The authority has clarified that the published list contains the details of registered candidates for UP NEET UG 2026 counselling. Therefore, candidates whose names appear on the list must ensure that they have completed the prescribed payment and document verification requirements before proceeding with choice filling.
 To view the merit list, click the link below 
 https://medicaldialogues.in/pdf_upload/2026/11/10/merit-list-482932.pdf
